about.description: Auxite provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: Auxite is a gold/silver tokenization platform issuing physical-metal-backed tokens (AUXG = gold, AXAU = gold, etc.). KYC-required at the issuer level; permissionless transfer once minted.

fees.revenueNotes: Auxite earns a primary-market premium over spot metals pricing plus ongoing storage/insurance fees on physical bullion held in third-party vaults.

events.reason: Mirrored from asset-level flags on canonical IDs AUXG, AUXS, AUXPT, AUXPD (RIDs 2837-2840): all four tokens silently redeployed 2026-06-08 (same day as launch press release) with prior Feb-2026 contracts abandoned; three mutually contradictory reserve figures (marketing page vs own API vs on-chain supply); no custodian, insurer, or auditor named despite "LBMA-accredited/insured/independently reviewed" claims; API attributes gold/silver to an undisclosed Istanbul vault; operator "Aurum Ledger Ltd, Hong Kong" not found in registries; ~100% of supply held by issuer treasury Safe; no CoinGecko/CMC listings. 1:1 backing unverified (2026-06-11).
